input.rationale: Section 4 addresses only the term, notice of termination and the Termination Payment; there is no exit provision anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for data, return, transition, migration and deletion return nothing relevant — Section 8 (Confidentiality) imposes non-disclosure obligations on HDI but no return or destruction obligation, and Section 10.7 (Survival) does not address exit. In a hosting arrangement where HDI holds our Content, user information and customer data, the absence of any data-return or transition mechanic falls below the fallback (90 days' assistance and 30-day export). We propose a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Company data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and deletion with written certification thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion clause in Section 4
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit provisions, so we are adding a new Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and to return our Content, user data and customer information in a machine-readable format within thirty days, then delete and certify deletion. We can accept a 90-day assistance period as a fallback, but need the 30-day data return.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.
